criteria.question: Is the participant aged 18 to 79 years?
criteria.original_text: Participant must be 18-<80 years of age at the time of signing the informed consent.

criteria.question: Is there a physician diagnosis of asthma for at least 6 months?
criteria.original_text: Physician diagnosis of asthma (according to GINA 2025) for ≥6 months

criteria.question: Does the patient have documented historical airflow variability via reversibility, challenge testing, or peak flow?
criteria.original_text: with documented historical airflow variability by one of the following: Positive reversibility test: ≥12% and 200 ml in FEV1 after SABA administration at any point prior to randomisation; Airflow variability in clinic FEV1 >12% and 200 mL between historical clinical visits; Positive bronchial challenge test: fall in FEV1 of ≥20% with standard doses of methacholine (<16 mg/mL or <400mcg); or ≥10% with standardised hyperventilation, or exercise challenge test; or ≥15% with hypertonic saline or mannitol challenge; Peak flow variability of >20% between two assessments

criteria.question: Is peripheral blood eosinophil count (BEC) >= 0.3 x 10^9/L at screening?
criteria.original_text: peripheral BEC ≥ 0.3×109/L at screening visit

criteria.question: Is FeNO >= 35 ppb at screening visit?
criteria.original_text: FeNO ≥ 35 ppb at screening visit

criteria.question: Did the patient have at least 1 asthma attack requiring systemic corticosteroids or an emergency/hospital visit in the last 2 years?
criteria.original_text: At least 1 asthma attack in the last 2 years, defined as acute asthma requiring SCS for ≥ 3 days or an emergency/hospital visit requiring SCS.

criteria.question: Has the patient been adherent to stable at least medium-dose ICS (fluticasone propionate >250 mcg/day equivalent) for at least 3 months?
criteria.original_text: Treatment and evident adherence to a stable at-least medium-dose ICS (fluticasone propionate equivalent >250 mcg/day) for at least 3 months (including run-in period)

criteria.question: Does the patient have uncontrolled asthma symptoms (ACQ5 >= 1.5), impaired lung function (post-BD FEV1 <= 80%), high-dose ICS, or severe asthma attack in past 1-12 months?
criteria.original_text: Presence of one (or more) of the following additional risk factors for asthma attacks at screening or baseline: (i) uncontrolled asthma symptoms indicated by ACQ5 score of ≥ 1.5; (ii) impaired lung function indicated by post-bronchodilator FEV1 of ≤ 80% predicted; (iii) high-dose maintenance ICS therapy (iv) severe asthma attack in past 1-<12 months.

applies_to.description: Female participants must not be pregnant or breastfeeding and must use highly effective contraception if of childbearing potential.

criteria.question: Is the female participant not pregnant/breastfeeding and using effective contraception if of childbearing potential?
criteria.original_text: A female participant is eligible to participate if she is not pregnant or breastfeeding, and at least one of the following conditions applies: Is a woman of nonchildbearing potential (WONCBP)... OR Is a WOCBP and agrees to use a contraceptive method that is highly effective

applies_to.description: WOCBP must have negative pregnancy tests at screening and prior to dosing.

criteria.question: Did the WOCBP have negative highly sensitive serum/urine pregnancy tests at screening and prior to first dose?
criteria.original_text: A WOCBP must have a negative highly sensitive serum pregnancy test at V1 (screening visit) and urine or serum pregnancy test on Day 1 before the first dose

criteria.question: Is the participant capable of giving signed informed consent and complying with study requirements?
criteria.original_text: Capable of giving signed informed consent which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the informed consent form (ICF) and in this protocol.

criteria.question: Has the patient used systemic corticosteroids in the last month or received maintenance systemic corticosteroids?
criteria.original_text: Use of SCS < 1 months prior to screening or on maintenance SCS.

criteria.question: Is the participant a current tobacco smoker or recently stopped smoker in the last 6 months?
criteria.original_text: Current tobacco smoker or recently stopped smoker (<6 months)

criteria.question: Is the ex-smoker with >10 pack-years exhibiting a post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC ratio below the lower limit of normal?
criteria.original_text: Ex-smoker with greater than 10 pack-years AND post bronchodilator FEV1/FVC ratio below the lower limit of normal according to GLI race-neutral standards.

criteria.question: Is there documented nonadherence to ICS (<75% dispensed over past 12 months based on pharmacy refill records)?
criteria.original_text: Documented nonadherence to ICS, defined as dispensing of less than 75% of the prescribed ICS dose over the past 12 months (or annualised if less than 12 months), based on pharmacy refill records checked at screening.

criteria.question: Does the patient have significant and uncorrectable inhaler technique deficiencies at screening?
criteria.original_text: Presence of significant and uncorrectable inhaler technique deficiencies, as assessed by the research team during inhaler technique evaluation at screening.

criteria.question: Is there any contra-indication to the study drug according to the investigator?
criteria.original_text: Contra-indication to study drug

criteria.question: Does the patient have an immunological disease or medication that may affect the inflammatory response?
criteria.original_text: Immunological disease, condition or medication that may affect the inflammatory response according to Investigator.

criteria.question: Does the patient have a history of other significant lung disease (e.g., lung fibrosis, sarcoidosis, COPD, bronchiectasis)?
criteria.original_text: History of other significant lung disease e.g. lung fibrosis, sarcoidosis, interstitial lung disease, pulmonary hypertension, clinically significant bronchiectasis, chronic obstructive lung disease, or Churg-Strauss.

criteria.question: Does the patient have a severe concomitant illness or suspected immunodeficiency that adversely affects participation?
criteria.original_text: Severe concomitant illness (including known or suspected immunodeficiency) that, in the Investigator's judgement will adversely affect the participant's participation in the study.

criteria.question: Is there an active malignancy or history of malignancy within 5 years (other than basal cell skin cancer or resected cervical dysplasia)?
criteria.original_text: Active malignancy or history of malignancy within 5 years (except for basal cell carcinoma of the skin or fully resected Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia/dysplasia).

criteria.question: Has the patient been exposed to monoclonal antibody therapy for asthma or investigational products within 5 half-lives?
criteria.original_text: Exposure to monoclonal antibody therapy for asthma or another investigational medicinal product within 5 half-lives of the drug.

criteria.question: Is the patient eligible for Dupilumab based on other licensed and reimbursed indications in their jurisdiction?
criteria.original_text: Eligibility to Dupilumab based on licensed and reimbursed indications in the participant's jurisdiction (e.g. nasal polyposis, atopic dermatitis, eosinophilic esophagitis, prurigo nodularis, etc.)

criteria.question: Has the patient received treatment with a live (attenuated) vaccine in the past 4 weeks?
criteria.original_text: Treatment with live (attenuated) vaccine in the past 4 weeks.

criteria.question: Is the patient taking any prohibited medication?
criteria.original_text: Prohibited medication

criteria.question: Does the patient have a current helminth infection?
criteria.original_text: Current helminth infection
